title: 第2781章 自加难度第2780章 狂妄又如何
slug: 乾坤至尊诀第2791章政变再变
content_zh:
毕竟是丹阁，效率极高。
也就半个时辰，五份药料，一只丹阁的制式丹炉安放到大广场处。
说起来，这万年多以来，丹阁还没有发生这样的事了。
特别丹阁的那些下层长老，执事，管事对这样的事，也只是听闻过，却没有见识过。
而今天，还真能亲眼目睹这样的事。
所以，无论对赵宇喜欢或讨厌的人都有份强烈的好奇心，就想当场见证这一奇迹。
为了这一刻，这些人手脚也十分麻利。
而且五份丹药也一一选取，这次选取的丹方，还是按照丹阁考核用的惯例。
这要求也是祝贺提出的。
摆好丹炉。
赵宇这次正步上前，再也没有一丝的轻狂，倒显得十分庄重。
他走到这只丹炉前，先摸了这只各类混金炼制的丹炉。
这是丹阁所用制式丹炉，也属虚仙级八品丹炉。
摩蹭一会儿后，丹炉没问题。
赵宇这次来丹阁时，已判断出丹阁中有人针对自己。
这也是他这次不走寻常路，要装狂耍狠。
又要在公共场合，公开测试的原因之一。
现在目的已达，也就没必要那么的装逼了。
丹炉没问题，便是炼丹的第一步，选料，一看各种药材的成份，年头，质量，份量是否达标。
这一步至关重要，必须严谨对待。

第二步，洗炉。
任何一只鼎炉，不可能只炼一种丹药。
如此，丹炉中必留有一些不该有残渣。
有时，一些关键的残渣，就算份量极少，也会影响这次成丹的质量。
甚至造成这次炼丹的失败。
所以，洗炉，清炉这一步骤也必不可少。
赵宇甄别完药材后，即刻开始清炉，洗炉。
于是，赵宇左手一伸，一块冰块落入炉鼎之内。
然后右手一拍，一缕青蓝色火焰立刻包裹住那只丹炉。
没有几息时间，一股水汽带着一股药味冲天而起。
而许多的高阶丹师，却一直紧盯着赵宇手中那一缕火焰。
因为作为一名丹师，自身掌控火焰的品级，对自身的成就那是至关重要。
这缕火焰能在几息时间，便可把一只八品鼎炉烧透，其品级一定极为强大。
更神奇的是，在他的身边，却没有一丝炽灼感。
那么原因有二，一是这种火焰有了神性，二是掌控之人，控火手段已达化境。
可这家伙明明只是小小的虚仙而已。
而今天在场的人，大部分都是行家，那种议论声再次响起，引起了阵阵“嗡嗡”
之声。
而更多人再次聚焦广场中间的赵宇，因为此时，赵宇却是极为专注，开始投注各类药材。
content_en:
After all, it is Dan Pavilion and is extremely efficient.
In just half an hour, five ingredients and a standard alchemy furnace from the Alchemy Pavilion were placed in the main square.
Speaking of which, such a thing has not happened in Dan Pavilion for more than ten thousand years.
Especially the lower-level elders, deacons, and stewards of Dan Pavilion have only heard of such things, but have never seen them.
And today, I can actually witness such a thing with my own eyes.
Therefore, everyone who likes or dislikes Zhao Yu has a strong curiosity and wants to witness this miracle on the spot.
For this moment, these people were very agile.
Moreover, the five elixirs were selected one by one. The elixir selected this time still followed the convention used in the Dan Pavilion assessment.
This request was also made in congratulations.
Set up the alchemy furnace.
Zhao Yu stepped forward this time. There was no trace of frivolity anymore, but he looked very solemn.
He walked to the alchemy furnace and first touched the alchemy furnace, which was made of various kinds of gold.
This is the standard alchemy furnace used by the Alchemy Pavilion, and it is also an eighth-grade Xuxian level alchemy furnace.
After rubbing it for a while, the alchemy furnace was fine.
When Zhao Yu came to Dan Pavilion this time, he had already judged that someone in Dan Pavilion was targeting him.
This is why he didn't take the usual route this time, pretending to be crazy and acting ruthless.
One of the reasons for conducting public testing in public places.
Now that the goal has been achieved, there is no need to be so pretentious.
There is nothing wrong with the alchemy furnace. This is the first step in making alchemy. Select the ingredients and check whether the ingredients, age, quality, and quantity of the various medicinal materials meet the standards.
This step is crucial and must be treated with rigor.
The second step is to wash the furnace.
It is impossible for any cauldron to refine only one kind of elixir.
In this way, there must be some residue in the alchemy furnace that should not be there.
Sometimes, some key residues, even in very small amounts, can affect the quality of the elixir.
It even caused the failure of this alchemy.
Therefore, the steps of washing and cleaning the furnace are also essential.
After Zhao Yu screened the medicinal materials, he immediately started cleaning and washing the furnace.
So, Zhao Yu stretched out his left hand, and a piece of ice fell into the furnace.
Then he clapped his right hand, and a wisp of blue flame immediately enveloped the alchemy furnace.
In just a few breaths, a stream of water vapor rose into the sky with a medicinal smell.
But many high-level alchemists have been staring at the wisp of flame in Zhao Yu's hand.
Because as an alchemist, controlling the level of the flame is crucial to one's own achievements.
This wisp of flame can burn through an eighth-grade cauldron in just a few breaths. Its grade must be extremely powerful.
What's even more amazing is that there is no burning sensation around him.
There are two reasons. One is that this kind of flame has divine nature, and the other is that the person who controls it has reached the realm of fire control.
But this guy is obviously just a little virtual immortal.
Most of the people present today are experts, and that kind of discussion resounded again, causing waves of "buzzing"
sound.
More people once again focused on Zhao Yu in the middle of the square, because at this time, Zhao Yu was extremely focused and began to invest in various medicinal materials.
